name: Yeodongsaeng ♡ Mandeulgi: Dangsin-i Balaneun Sonyeoui Moseub
original_name: 여동생 ♡ 만들기 : 당신이 바라는 소녀의 모습
source:
Suhan, who goes to high school, is frustrated because he can't get along with his younger sister Sunmi. One day, he went to his friend Jinyong's house and saw Jinyong get along very well with his sister. To the envious Suhan, Jinyong pulls out a small stone, saying, 'I was never on good terms with my sister either, but this helped us get along.'

The stone had the mysterious power to change what had happened in the past. Suhan used stones to change poor Sunmi's memories one by one, and because of the changed past, he was able to get closer to Sunmi. Suhan fell in love with changing the past, and then things happened that never occurred...

[From [url=https://mindle35.itch.io/my-little-sister-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
正在上高中的苏汉因为无法与妹妹宣美相处而感到沮丧。有一天，他去朋友金庸家，看到金庸和妹妹相处得很好。对于嫉妒的苏涵，金庸掏出一块小石头说：“我和姐姐关系一直不好，但这有助于我们相处。”

这块石头具有神秘的力量，可以改变过去发生的事情。苏汉用石头一一改变了可怜的宣美的记忆，也因为改变了过去，才能够和宣美走得更近。苏涵爱上了改变过去，然后从未发生过的事情发生了……

[来自[url=https://mindle35.itch.io/my-little-sister-prologue]itch.io[/url]]
